release_blockers.remaining: Unresolved; earlier failed endpoints differ by one stale checksum-valid page with matching parent pointers. A follow-up independently reproduces stale buffered I/O on Mac/scratch using C without E4; identical Pi/server C controls pass. Concurrent instrumented E4 also catches read-versus-last-write mismatches. This establishes an external I/O failure class, not the exact cause of every historical failure. Requalify the frozen candidate on native storage; do not declare the older Store fixed. See SCAN_IO_ISOLATION.md. Full corrected baseline/candidate workspace suites and 200K/800K exact shuffled oracles now pass on both Linux hosts. Historical Mac causality and post-reboot Mac I/O qualification remain separate; do not infer that every old failure is resolved.

server overlayfs reports candidate allocated peak 263061504 bytes from 110202880 loaded bytes (2.387x); baseline and SQLite also exceed 2x. Logical admission is not a proven filesystem/physical allocation bound. Pi measured peaks remain about 1.14x. Identify allocation semantics and qualify a genuine disk-full budget before claiming the 2x physical guarantee. Follow-up controls identify unwritten XFS extents beyond EOF beneath the server OverlayFS PVC. Batched explicit reservation around unchanged E4 cuts fresh worst sampled allocation from 263716864 to 126877696 bytes; its median mutation times remain below 1.5x SQLite on both Linux hosts. This diagnostic does not account reservation against the engine cap: a 4096-byte file receives 1048576 allocated bytes. No runtime change; integrate bounded reservation admission and validate refusal/recovery plus any required filesystem allocation boundary before claiming a physical guarantee. See ALLOCATION_LOOP.md.
